_about: Hand-checked extra domains for scripts/rank-1001.py (1001 Rank). A company is measured on its census URL plus the domains listed here. Add a domain only with evidence that the company runs it (its page names the company or its legal entity, the census site links to it, or the census URL redirects to it), and give the evidence in 'why'. 'hold' keeps a company out of the rank with a reason. The job never adds a domain on its own.
